description: Several families submit same-day transportation changes, and the dispatcher must reconcile which updates are confirmed, provisional, denied, or too late to honor without mixing them up. All schools and families are fictional.

user_profile.persona: 32-year-old dispatch office coordinator handling volatile afternoon change traffic
user_profile.context: The same-day changes are individually small, but together they create too much risk for informal tracking
user_profile.communication_style: Fast and status-driven, wants each requested change tied to a clear final disposition

fact_sheet.fact: The afternoon shift Dispatch Coordinator is Alex Chen.
Alex Chen works at workstation D-04 in the main operations center.
The direct phone line for the dispatch office is 555-821-4000, extension 2.
Alex Chen's shift runs from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
The primary software for managing transportation changes is 'DispatchPro 7'.
The login URL for DispatchPro 7 is https://dispatch.ridewell.edu/login.
Parents submit same-day transportation changes via the 'SwiftRide' parent portal.
Internal dispatch team communication for urgent issues is handled in the Slack channel #afternoon-dispatch.
The firm cutoff time for same-day transportation change submissions is 1:00 PM local time.
Any change request submitted via the SwiftRide portal after 1:00 PM is automatically assigned the status 'Too Late'.
A change request status of 'Confirmed' in DispatchPro 7 triggers an automated SMS notification to the parent's registered phone number.
A request status of 'Denied' requires the dispatcher to select a reason from a predefined list, such as 'Outside Zone' or 'Safety Concern'.
The 'Provisional' status means a request has been acknowledged by dispatch but has not yet been assigned to a specific driver's route.
The maximum allowable route deviation for an alternate drop-off request is 1.5 miles from the original route.
Request #CHG-20231026-008 for Emily White (Student ID 33214) to be picked up by her grandmother, Carol White, was marked 'Confirmed' at 12:45 PM.
Request #CHG-20231026-015 for Maya Singh (Student ID 45678) was 'Denied' because the requested drop-off at 9200 Industrial Park Rd is outside the approved zone for Maple Creek Elementary.
Request #CHG-20231026-011 for twins, Ava and Noah Kim (Student IDs 54321, 54322), is currently 'Provisional' pending driver confirmation for a 0.8-mile route deviation.
Request #CHG-20231026-021, submitted at 1:15 PM for Liam Johnson (Student ID 99870), was automatically marked 'Too Late'.
Request #CHG-20231026-012 for Leo Rodriguez (Student ID 78912) to be dropped at Northwood Public Library (1550 Elm Street) was 'Confirmed' and assigned to Bus #14.
Bus #14 is a 2022 Blue Bird Vision model with license plate S-BUS 781.
Sarah Jenkins is the assigned driver for Bus #14, which services Route 7B.
All bus drivers use a company-issued 'RoutePad 5' tablet to receive real-time updates from dispatch.
The emergency contact for driver Sarah Jenkins is listed as Mark Jenkins at 555-234-5678.
Maple Creek Elementary's official dismissal time is 2:45 PM.
Northwood Elementary's official dismissal time is 3:00 PM.
The Rodriguez family's primary contact number for SMS notifications is 555-901-2345.
The Kim family has a pre-authorized alternate drop-off address at 450 Oak Avenue, which is on file.
The IT support contact for DispatchPro 7 software issues is Ben Carter at bcarter@ridewell.edu.
Alex Chen must generate and email the 'End-of-Day Change Log Summary' (Report ID: EOD-CHG-SUM) to the operations manager before clocking out.
